Name: Naphtali
Summary: Naphtali was the sixth son of Jacob, the second by Bilhah, and the father of Jahzeel, Guni, Jezer, and Shillem.
KeyStory: Naphtali's tribe later became known for beautiful words, just as Jacob had blessed him.
RelatedPeople: Jacob; Bilhah; Jahzeel; Guni; Jezer; Shillem
LifeLesson: God's story keeps moving through families we know almost nothing about — and He knows them all.
